system.description: Your Energy Core can store Charges like Tech cards (up to 1 Charge). After a long rest, your Energy Core gains a Charge. Spend a Charge to activate a module; it lasts until the scene ends or you activate another module.

attribution.source: The New Unknown Playtest v2.0 Mind

system.gmNotes: Raise this resource's maximum to 2 at Enhanced Core and 3 at Masterwork Core. The long-rest recovery refills to the maximum; the playtest grants one Charge after a long rest and loses unused Charges, so set the value to 1 by hand after a long rest from Enhanced Core on. Modules are separate features: the system can only charge a cost to the resource on the same item, so spend the Charge from the Energy Core by hand when you activate a module.
